name: Obelisk Strike
description: An ancient obelisk has surfaced at the heart of the battlefield, its markings pulsing with a power both sides intend to claim before the other.

setup.label: Obelisk
setup.description: There is 1 Objective Marker at the center of the field.

results.text: Gain 1 VP for unlocking the Cache.
Gain 2 VP if your model has the Treasure in its Inventory at the end of the game.

questRules.description: At the start of each Strategic Phase, any model within 2" of the Obelisk may attempt to unlock it, gaining access to the Cache for the remainder of the game.
